name: Sudden Geysers
disable: DC 32 Arcana or DC 32 Nature (master) to dissipate the fire-aligned energies in the water, or DC 28 Diplomacy or DC 28 Religion to beseech Sangeh and convince her to momentarily tamp down her mythic power; two successes are required to disable the hazard
routine: (2 actions) The hazard uses each of its actions to create a Blistering Plume centered on a space chosen by the GM. Each successful check to disable the hazard removes one action from this routine.

offensiveAbilities.name: Scalding Gout
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within the hazard's area rolls initiative

Effect A enormous column of superheated steam rises from the water, dealing (4d12+26) Fire Damage damage to all creatures in the area (Basic DC 28 Reflex Saving Throw save). On a critical failure, the creature also takes 1d12 Persistent,fire Damage damage as the water continues to burn their skin. The hazard then rolls initiative.

offensiveAbilities.name: Blistering Plume
offensiveAbilities.description: A 30-foot-tall geyser erupts from the boiling water. Creatures in a 5ft Type:emanation of the geyser take (2d12+13) Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 30 Reflex Saving Throw save).
